PDF Sphere Tracing: A Geometric Method for the Antialiased Ray Tracing of ...
Sphere tracing is a ray tracing technique that uses geometric distance to march along the ray toward the first intersection with the implicit surface. It is robust, efficient and supports antialiasing for pathological surfaces with discontinuous or undefined derivatives.
